tile: Use case: stylized-concept. Reference image: supplied original Vestiges celestes painting, STYLE AND MATERIAL REFERENCE ONLY. Create ONE isolated game sprite: a broad rectangular ancient blue stone stair tread / mosaic paving slab, matching the small loose indigo-blue tile on the foreground of the reference. Single solid connected slab centred and filling most of image, enough transparent margin. Actual transparent background, no scene, no floor, no checkerboard paint, no text, no duplicate tile, no sprite sheet. This asset will be repeated at smaller sizes to form a curving magical stairway, so give it substantial stone thickness and a clear readable tread.
